control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console R-1: report list and reconciliation queue (Report vs Report Automation), ordered by age, with reason codes and restricted bulk approve.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] (ID, Title, ScheduleID, HostID, BrandID, AccountID, Platform, Account, LiveDate, 7+5 metrics, ApprovalStatus, Match, ApprovalComment, Approver, Created, Modified).

property.name: EvidenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report Automation - PBS Hub] for the same reports (ID, Title, HostID, ScheduleID, AccountID, metrics, Status, Created).

property.name: BrandsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Brand - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaBrand.

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost. Never send KTP or NoRekening.

property.name: Mode
property.description-key: Admin shows bulk approve; ReadOnly hides every decision.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when canvas can load more rows (server paging): shows Muat lebih banyak and emits LOAD_MORE.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: OPEN_REPORT, BULK_APPROVE, LOAD_MORE, FILTER_CHANGED, NAV.
